I’m a licensed psychologist and postdoctoral researcher at Karolinska Institutet, where I work at the Centre for Psychiatry Research in the Department of Clinical Neuroscience.

My current research focuses on relapse prevention following treatment for obsessive-compulsive disorder in children and adolescents, including the development of digital symptom monitoring and just-in-time support.

My previous research has focused on adult ADHD, work-related mental health, and internet-delivered psychological interventions.

I received my PhD in Psychology from Stockholm University in 2026.
